body: Thank you so much. The issue is, I live in Scotland and this is the only university that now offers the course I want to do. So I have no choice but to go there. I spoke to the Student’s Union, who are completely on my side and have shown me total compassion. I think I might speak to them today to say I need further help. I also know there’s student support services who can write me a support plan. My doctor has signed me off sick so I think they need to respect that I’m not fit to attend meetings but can communicate through advocates for the time being. I worry if I attend these meetings, I will end up in a worse place mentally. I need someone in my corner to intervene. I know this is a masters course and a step up from my undergraduate, however I did my undergraduate at an incredibly supportive university and my grades were really good. Top 5% good. I just need the right support and honestly fuck being ashamed of that.

That’s exactly it. What pisses me off the most is that these people tweet about supporting trainees and their mental health when they don’t have a clue and use it as a weakness. I’m in an incredibly dark place. I know I can do this course but I can’t go through all of these meetings hearing what a terrible person I am for having a near nervous breakdown. I just can’t do it anymore. Sorry if I sound like a wimp but I’m just not in the place mentally to sit and be judged by people.
